items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Well at the time when I played with him, my brother and I was playing clarinet.

ctx.x: Manuel Gabriel. Manuel Gabriel. Manuel Gabriel. Everybody calls him Manny.

Yes, quite a few people have mentioned him especially when we've talked to him. Yeah. I wonder if you have time to go over that other brass band picture again that's in back of you here. I know it's all torn to shreds almost. It's a wonderful old picture. If you can remember, in case our picture didn't reproduce perfectly, we'll read this name.
